headline: From zero to almost 30 million euros in seven years. Consartfan's bet on renewable energy
summary: Consartfan has grown from zero to almost €30 million in seven years through its renewable energy investments. The growth comes as Romania accelerates investment in new generation capacity.
why: Renewable energy developers benefit from national investment in power generation and grid integration, which shapes project pipelines and financing.
